title: Karl Nell says disclosure is dead

tellings.quote: Um, but he just went on a podcast and he said disclosure is dead.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Karl Nell recently went on a podcast and declared that disclosure is dead. Disclosure here means the hoped-for moment when the US government openly reveals what it knows about non-human intelligence, so if Nell is right, that moment is not coming any time soon.
